instructions_to_main_agent: Create a new unified hub page called 'SB Market' that acts as the central marketplace index within the super-app.
Implement the UI fully in French as requested ('Immobilier', 'Véhicules', 'Location', 'Marketplace').
Use Lucide-React icons for the category grid (Home, Car, Key, Package/ShoppingBag).
The layout must be strictly mobile-first (max-w-md mx-auto) mimicking a super-app section.
Build a reusable `<ListingCard>` component that works for all 4 verticals. It should conditionally render badges like 'À la une' (Boosted) or 'Pro' based on props.
Implement horizontal scroll for 'À la une / Annonces boostées' (Featured carousel) using the snap-x utility classes.
Implement a 'Publier une annonce' floating button anchored to the bottom.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Add 'Manrope' font via Google Fonts in the main index.html or apply font-sans if setup is standard.
Do not break existing pages, just link the new SB Market hub to coordinate them.
